From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: ClearCove - Payments activation & remittance layout

Hi Liam / ClearCove AP team,

Thanks for agreeing to move forward — we're ready to finish the vendor activation on our side. Attached is our vendor onboarding form and a short checklist. A couple of things we need to finalize so Finance can kick off the first remit: 

- Confirm bank account details / ACH routing (we typically accept a PDF bank letter or a micro‑deposit verification). If you prefer wire only, confirm wire routing and SWIFT.
- Provide completed W‑9 (or W‑8 if applicable).
- Confirm how you want remittance lines encoded on payouts. Our preferred format is PO|INVOICE_NUMBER|AMOUNT but happy to adapt if you provide a sample CSV.
- Which PO prefix should we map? (ex: CCV- for ClearCove PO numbers)

I attached a sample remit CSV and our onboarding form — if you can return the completed form and W‑9 and either a bank letter or a screenshot of the micro‑deposits, we can finalize in Finance and schedule the first payment run.

Next steps after you reply: Jordan (cc'd) will confirm PO mapping with our billing system and Marissa will kick off the DocuSign onboarding packet.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha,

Thanks — attached are the completed onboarding form and our W‑9. We just posted micro‑deposits this morning to the account on file (two amounts: $0.12 and $0.37) — screenshot attached. Bank prefers ACH for routine invoices; wires will be used for expedited/initial setup if needed.

Remit CSV: we've attached a short sample of how our system exports remittance details (column order: invoice, PO, remit_code, amount). For mapping, we use PO numbers with the prefix CCV- followed by a 6‑digit number (example: CCV-001234).

Let us know if you need any additional verification.

Best,
Liam O'Connor

Thanks Liam — received. Quick internal notes and request for confirmation: 

- Marissa: I'll prepare the vendor record in Billable and will set PO mapping to strip the "CCV-" prefix and map the 6‑digit numeric portion to our PO field. Confirm?
- Aisha: we'd like to put the ClearCove remit code into the invoice metadata as "CLEARCOVE_PAYCODE" so Finance can apply automated reconciliation. Liam / AP: can you confirm that including a "remit_code" column in the CSV (as in your sample) is stable across your exports?
- DocuSign: Marissa will send DocuSign onboarding (bank consent + payment terms). Liam, please sign the DocuSign packet so we can complete the activation. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/clearcove/onboarding/abc123

Also noting: we'll run the first test ACH on Wednesday 8/12 and then schedule the first full remittance the following Friday (8/19) pending successful reconciliation. If you need the wire for the first payment, flag it now and we can switch to wire instructions for the initial run.

Jordan
Senior FinOps Analyst
Redwood Inference
